summary: US-led strikes against Iran have entered their third consecutive night. Iranian officials have warned that retaliation for strikes on central Iranian sites will not be limited to Iranian territory. Israel has targeted and killed the military security chief of Hamas's Jabalia central battalion.
key_points: The US Central Command reported the third consecutive night of strikes against Iran (Source: @pkpoi/143282).
Israel targeted and killed Mohammad Marwan Mohammad Salem, the military security chief of Hamas's Jabalia central battalion, in northern Gaza (Source: @yediotnews25/132691).
An Iranian official stated that if the US attacks central Iran or nuclear sites, retaliation will extend beyond Iranian territory (Source: @pkpoi/143283).
The Iranian military spokesperson stated that Iranian forces will not retreat from their position regarding the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @pkpoi/143285).
President Trump has threatened to impose a 20% toll on cargo passing through the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4982).

The Kuwaiti military reported intercepting one ballistic missile, five cruise missiles, and 33 hostile drones, resulting in damage to vital facilities and injuries to four personnel (Source: @naya_foriraq/83039).
Israel's Defense Minister Katz requested a presidential pardon for former soldier Elor Azaria (Source: @manniefabian/58785).
The Israeli Knesset passed a law to freeze military draft exemptions with a 58-vote majority (Source: @pkpoi/143282).

sections.executive_summary: US-led airstrikes against Iran have reached their third consecutive night of operations. Iranian officials have issued warnings that retaliation for strikes on central Iranian sites will extend beyond Iranian territory. In Gaza, the IDF successfully targeted the military security chief of Hamas's Jabalia central battalion.

The Iranian military spokesperson declared that forces will not retreat from their position regarding the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @pkpoi/143285).

The IDF strike in Gaza City killed Osama Naim Hamdi Shamlakh, a commander of a Hamas naval force cell (Source: @manniefabian/58784).
Defense Minister Israel Katz submitted a request to the president to pardon former soldier Elor Azaria (Source: @manniefabian/58785).

The IDF killed the military security chief of Hamas's Jabalia central battalion and several other militants in northern Gaza (Source: @New_security8200/202575).

sections.threat_assessment: The situation is escalating due to sustained US-led strikes against Iran and warnings of non-territorial retaliation. The potential for maritime disruption in the Strait of Hormuz is high following threats of new tolls and Iranian refusal to retreat from their position. Regional tensions are heightened by the ongoing IDF operations in Gaza targeting Hamas leadership.
sections.regional_response: Iran has signaled a readiness for expanded conflict if central sites are targeted. Kuwaiti forces have actively engaged and intercepted multiple aerial and ballistic threats, reporting injuries to four personnel. The US is moving toward imposing economic measures, such as tolls in the Strait of Hormuz.
sections.intelligence_notes: The targeting of Hamas's military security leadership in Jabalia indicates continued focus on degrading command structures. The use of 'Mount Muscus' as a potential target highlights the strategic importance of Iranian hardened underground facilities. Monitoring of maritime traffic in the Strait of Hormuz is critical due to potential economic and military escalations.
